## Type of change

- [ ] Normative — schema (`schema/`) or closed codelist values
- [ ] Non-normative — docs, examples, or open codelist values
- [ ] Tooling / CI

> **Normative changes** to `schema/` or closed codelists go through the Concert
> Standards Committee revision process with a published comment period. Please
> link the relevant proposal or discussion.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally (all examples valid against the schema)
- [ ] New or changed objects have a worked example under `examples/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Where prose and schema could disagree, the **schema** is authoritative
- [ ] I have read and agree to the [Contributor Licence Agreement](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
